tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lce btsun snying tig gi bka' srung rgyun gtor phrin las thogs med bzhugs so// na mo gu ra we/

gang zhig snying po'i rnal 'byor don/ /bka' srung rgyun gtor rdo rje'i tshig /cung zad bkral la gnang ba stsol/ /dngos 'byor gtor ma gser skyems sogs/ /mchod tshogs 'du bya rig rtsal las/ /yongs shar bla ma dpal chen po'i/ /skur bzhengs ting nge 'dzin la gnas ngang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsregs gtor bkrus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs bsgyur spel/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyis/ /snang srid khams kun gang bar gyur/ /rang bzhin chos dbyings zhing khams nas/ /bzhugs pa'i rtsa gsum dam can mgron/ /gsang ba'i gnas 'dir mchod bzhes slad/ /skad cig badzra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho sa brtan par bzhugs/ /dpal sngags kyi srung ma ni/ a: dbyings las ye shes rang shar ba'i/ /'bum phrag mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ /bcu bdun rgyud kyi bya ra ba/ /e ka dza ṭī ral gcig ma/ /'khor dang yang 'khor bshan pa'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs bzhugs gsol phyag mchod bzhes/ /phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi /snang srid rnam dag mchod pa 'bul/ /dam skong 'khor 'das rang grol la/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis rtog shor ba bshags/ /gsang ba snying po'i bstan pa srung*/ /'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i mdzad phrin spel/ /chos ldan sbyin bdag mgon skyabs mdzod/ /lta log gtams pa'i snying khrag 'thung*/ /las bcol rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs/ /ma ma trag raksha e ka dza ṭī sarba pū dza ba liṃ ta kha ram̐ khā hi/ drang srong gza' mchog chen po ni/ dzaḥ 'od gsal rig pa zang thal sku/ /sa dgu'i mnga' bdag dregs pa'i gtso/ /khyab mjug chen po sgra gcan 'dzin/ /gdong mo bzhi dang sde brgyad tshogs/ /mchod gtor 'di bzhes tha tshig dgongs/ /snying po'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde/ /srung skyob sdong grogs g.yel med mdzod/ /lta log ru tra'i sde dpung bcas/ /gzugs can gzugs med dgra bgegs rnams/ /gtad do ming gi lhag mar gyis/

/phrin las ma g.yel sa ma ya/ oṃ ke ta ke ta raksha rā hu la sa pā ri wā ra/ ma hā maṃ sa rakta tsitta ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ dam can skyes bu ni/ triḥ dbyings dang rig pa 'du 'bral med/ /zung 'jug dwangs ma'i thig le 'dzin/ /'dzam gling gter gyi srung ma mchog /rdo rje legs pa dgra 'dul rtsal/ /mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu dang*/ /yang 'khor lha srin sde brgyad bcas/ /'dir gshegs dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tha tshig bzhin/ /dbang dang drag po'i phrin las kyis/ /gzhi byes lam gsum grogs tan mdzod/ /mgon dang dpal du khyod ngom na/ /mthu rtsal nus pa myur du ston/ /dam tshig dus babs phrin las mdzod/ /tri badzra sā dhu sa ma ya sarba pū dza kha raṃ khā hi/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs ni/ hūm̐/ thugs rje'i cho 'phrul bsam yas pa/ /dpal chen bka' sdod tha tshig bdag /'bum phrag dregs pa'i sde tshogs kun/ /'dir gshegs dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin la sdang ba'i/ /do bsdau phod btsugs yid srub ste/ /gzugs can gzugs med nyams pa'i tshogs/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i zas skal du/ /gtad do mngon spyod phrin las mdzod/ /dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa pā ri wā ra/ ma hā maṃ sa rakta tsitta la kha raṃ khā hi/ tha tshig phrin las bcol ba ni/ kyai dgongs brda snyan nas brgyud pa yi/ /rgyal ba rig 'dzin rnal 'byor dbang*/ /ji snyed 'dus pa'i tshogs chen dang*/ /'khor 'das zil gnon he ru ka /dpal chen siṃ he shwa ra dang*/ /'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje yis/ /ji ltar bka' bsgos dam bzhag bzhin/ /bka' srung bstan srung gter bdag tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /dur khrod rol pa'i gnas 'dir byon/ /khams lnga dag pa'i sman phud dang*/ /'byung lnga'i dwangs ma ba liṃ ta/ /dug lnga bsgral ba'i dmar chen po/ /bde stong bla med gsang mchod bzhes/

/theg mchog lam du zhugs pa la/ /glau bur bdud bzhi'i bar chad zlog /chags med byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /nges med nyer rgyu spyod pa'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i phrin las bsgrubs/ /'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba'i tshe/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sa bon sgrol/ /rig pa ka dag lta ba la/ /yid byed mtshan ma'i rtog pa srungs/ /rig rtsal mngon sum snang ba'i tshe/ /rlung sems 'gyu ba dbyings su non/ /mthar thug gzhi dbyings gnyug ma'i klong*/ /gzhi snang rig pa'i phrin las sgrubs/ /yang gsang 'phags lam rdzogs chen gyi/ /bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin skyes bu yi/ /las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med sgrubs/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar mdzod/ /sa ma ya ho: gter zhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang la/ /cung zad gsal bar bkral ba'i dges/ /rnal 'byor phrin las kun 'grub nas/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /ces rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi zhing don gnyis 'grub pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu rig 'dzin sna tshogs rang grol pas bkra shis dung dkar 'khyil ba'i ri zhol rang gnas bsam gtan gyi khang bur bris pa dge legs su gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o// //
